race.comment: THISISMYTURF (5) is well seasoned but surprisingly had first try at the mile last time, and after going back from a wide gate flashed home to place. This is slightly easier and looks hard to hold out with a repeat. REGAL HUNTER (4) has been in the placings his past two starts, finishing second over 1650m at Devonport Synthetic last time out. Will find this tougher but is capable of featuring. JOHNNIE PINCH (2) took up the running last time and turned in front but faded to finish fourth, beaten 4.5 lengths, over this journey at this track. Well placed and expected to feature. SIR JAG (3) is in great form, the latest running on well to finish runner-up here over the mile. Drawn to feature with the top hoop aboard.
